title: Eddoboozi ly'amagezi mu bisiikirize
intro: Omusajja ow’edda, amanyiddwa olw’okutegeera okw’amaanyi, ayogera naawe okumala ebyasa bingi. Ono ssekinnoomu teyagambangako nti ye nnabbi, naye ate amagezi ag’obwakatonda gaali gakulukuta mu bigambo byabwe. Omuzadde eyaleka omusika ogw’olubeerera ogw’obulagirizi, amagezi ge gasigala nga gakuumibwa mu mitima gy’obukadde n’obukadde, nga gasomeddwa era ne gafumiitiriza n’okutuusa leero.
clues: Nafuna ekirabo eky’obwakatonda ekyanjawula - amagezi amazibu ennyo ne gafuuka engeri yange etegeeza mu byafaayo byonna.
Saali mubaka wadde malayika - mwoyo gwokka ogwaweebwa omukisa okutegeera okw’amaanyi n’okutegeera ensi.
Omukwano gwange ogw’oku lusegere gwali n’omwana wange era okuyita mu mukwano guno, obubaka bwange obusinga okuwangaala bwatuusibwa.
Nakubiriza okwebaza oyo eyampa buli kimu, era ne ndabula ku malala n’amalala.
Nayigiriza ku buzito bw’ebikolwa ebibalirirwamu wadde ensigo ya mukene, n’obukulu bw’okukkakkanya eddoboozi ly’omuntu mu bwetoowaze.
Essuula mu Quran eyitibwa erinnya lyange, okubuulirira kwange eri omwana wange omwagalwa kwe kukuumibwa emirembe gyonna.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
